question_stem:
The circuit of an amplifier incorporating an ideal operational amplifier (op-amp) is shown in Fig. 7.1.

{{figure:figure_7_1}}

parts.label: (a)
parts.part_stem: By reference to the properties of an ideal op-amp,

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: explain why point P is referred to as a $virtual$ $earth$,

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: derive an expression, in terms of the resistances $R_1$ and $R_2$, for the gain of the amplifier circuit.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: On Fig. 7.2, show the variation with time $t$ of the output potential $V_{OUT}$.
